messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Losartan is used alone or in combination with other medications to treat high blood pressure in adults and children at least 6 years old.
Losartan is also used to decrease the risk of stroke in people who have high blood pressure and a heart condition called left ventricular hypertrophy (enlargement of the walls of the left side of the heart).
Losartan may not decrease the risk of stroke in African Americans who have these conditions.
Losartan is also used to treat kidney disease in people who have type 2 diabetes (condition in which the body does not use insulin normally and therefore cannot control the amount of sugar in the blood) and high blood pressure.
Losartan belongs to a class of medications called angiotensin II receptor antagonists. It works by blocking the action of certain natural substances that tighten the blood vessels, allowing the blood to flow more smoothly and the heart to pump more efficiently.
Triplet: ["Losartan", "does not reduce risk of", "stroke in African Americans with high blood pressure and left ventricular hypertrophy"]

The relation 'does not reduce risk of' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug does not lower the risk of the medical condition or event specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'contraindicated in': The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
B. 'reduces risk of': The subject drug is used to prevent or lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'not approved for': The subject drug is not approved or not recommended for use in the patient population specified by the object entity.
D. 'should be avoided with': Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.
E. 'not used to treat': The subject drug is inappropriate or contraindicated for the treatment of the condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
